title: Scalpel and Brush: Pruning and Targeted Weight Editing of a Small Language Model by a Single LLM Agent
abstract: arXiv:2611.33426v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: It has recently been shown that an LLM can itself edit the weights of a language model, yet it remains unclear which part of such a result is due to the agent and which part is reproduced by a random edit of the same shape, by an instruction in the prompt, or by a standard procedure without an LLM. We unify repair and pruning as sparse weight edits to optimize a metric we specify, using BLEU as an example: three tasks -- targeted weight repair ("brush"), structured MLP neuron pruning ("scalpel", zeroing pruned weights), and layer removal with repair - are assigned to a DeepSeek Harness agent powered by DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash, with up to 50 dev evaluations. We study Qwen2.5-Math-1.5B-Instruct in three independent runs per task, with final evaluation on two hidden splits. On ordinary differential equations, changing at most 0.0084% of weights raised test BLEU by 24-32% on second-order equations and by a factor of 1.8-2.5 on equations with pol

translated_title: 手术刀与画笔：利用单个大语言模型智能体对小语言模型进行剪枝与针对性权重编辑
translated_abstract: 近期有研究表明，大语言模型（LLM）本身可以编辑语言模型的权重，但目前仍不清楚这类结果中哪些部分归功于智能体，哪些部分可以被相同形状的随机编辑、提示词中的指令、或不使用LLM的标准流程所复现。我们将修复与剪枝统一为稀疏权重编辑，以优化我们指定的指标（以BLEU为例）：三项任务——针对性权重修复（“画笔”）、结构化MLP神经元剪枝（“手术刀”，将被剪枝的权重置零）以及层移除并修复——被分配给由DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash驱动的DeepSeek Harness智能体，最多进行50次开发集评估。我们以每个任务三次独立运行的方式研究Qwen2.5-Math-1.5B-Instruct模型，并在两个隐藏的数据划分上进行最终评估。在常微分方程任务上，仅改动最多0.0084%的权重，就在二阶方程上将测试BLEU提升了24-32%，在含多项式项的方程上提升了1.8-2.5倍。
tldr: 该论文通过严格的对照实验首次系统地证明，单个LLM智能体能够通过稀疏权重编辑（针对性修复、结构化剪枝与层移除）改进小语言模型，仅修改0.0084%的权重即可在常微分方程任务上使BLEU提升24-32%乃至2.5倍，并排除了随机编辑等因素的干扰。
en_tdlr: This paper provides controlled evidence that a single LLM agent can genuinely improve a small language model through sparse weight edits—targeted repair, structured pruning, and layer removal—changing only 0.0084% of weights to boost BLEU by 24-32% up to 2.5x on ordinary differential equation tasks.
